hints.input: The tool only parses the source; it never executes any code.
hints.action: Validate only reports whether the syntax is legal; it does not rewrite the content.
hints.indent: The indent width is measured in spaces; 2, 4 and 8 are available.
hints.semi: Disabling the option removes trailing semicolons; semicolons inside strings are untouched.
hints.output: Format re-indents with the chosen width; minify removes comments and redundant whitespace but keeps variable names.

faq.a: No. Minify only removes comments and whitespace; identifiers are kept as they are.

faq.q: Does the quote swap cause damage?
faq.a: Only lines that consist of a single string literal are converted, so double quotes elsewhere in the code are left alone.
No. The tool parses ECMAScript syntax, so type annotations are reported as syntax errors.
